summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by Structured Obligations Corporation, reporting a regular distribution (interest payment) to holders of Select Notes Trust LT 2003-3 certificates. The filing includes the trustee's report covering the May 15, 2026 interest distribution date, with interest received of $110,625.00 ($3.111814 per certificate). No special situation event—such as a merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or other corporate action—is described. The disclosure is a standard ongoing reporting obligation for an asset-backed security trust, not a special situation. No further action or risk-arb angle exists.
